## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `c787516002073313824885c6eefc3691e0560f23` · 2026-11-24T20:50Z

Requested by zone a4-S (7143932527) for card #36900.

Sound as built: the design surface hands the palette its own groups, loaded only while it is open; the package's menu groups and items (with its `.custom` pair) come from the existing menu model and the #36895 address builder; no second ⌘K title rule (#35308); no other ⌘K owner in Studio, browser Ctrl+K blocked, pillar Escape handlers ignore the palette's; the palette lists nothing the menu or list pages would hide; no new i18n key; cmdk roles and labelled headings; no per-keystroke reads. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch: right (app-shell private, no export or key change). Check-runs: 38 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed.

M1 (must-fix) — a palette pick can drop unsaved edits without asking. Picks go through `confirmLeavePillar` (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ~1253-1259, `CommandPalette.tsx` ~423), which checks only the pillar's own unsaved flags (~476); the All-metadata item page (`ResourceEditPage`) records its edits only with the shell's guard (~2670), so ⌘K leaves it silently — the old palette path and the menu's links both asked. Fix: leave through `confirmUnsavedLeave(...)` for both "leave" and "re-enter"; pin it on the real item page with unsaved edits and a spied `window.confirm`, cancel and OK.
S1 (should-fix) — `StudioPaletteGroups.tsx` copies `GROUP_ICONS` / `ENTRY_LABEL_KEYS` and re-implements `useStudioMenuTypes` from `StudioMenu.tsx`, re-reading types and the diagnostics sweep on every open. Export the hook and maps, or share the menu's data through context.
S2 (should-fix) — `studioPaletteModel.ts` restates `scopeListRows` (`metadataListState.ts`) and drops the list page's `include: listInclude`. Call `scopeListRows`.
S3 (should-fix) — `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md` still says the studio-scope palette "takes no other prop"; document `surface`.
S4 (should-fix) — internal names reach users: `StudioPaletteGroups.tsx` (~250) shows a `.custom` item's raw package id; the changeset body carries `~org`, `~all`, `.custom`, `?package=`, "leg", "address builder" into the CHANGELOG. Use the package label / customization wording and write the changeset in product terms.
S5 (should-fix) — the "re-enter" path (Default sharing opened from the Access pillar) is tested only on the pure decision function; closing the palette changes the query before the navigation, and the page's remount trigger fires on the first query change (~1231-1240). Pin it on the real page.
D2 (should-fix, deviation) — the live walk-through cannot be deferred to #36910: its body says each designer card and this one carry their own walk-through, and it is itself blocked. Run this card's walk-through after M1 and attach it.
D1 (accepted) — first push before the overlap check; no harm, later runs merge clean.

Nits: N1 `MetadataQuickFind` on ⌘⇧M (`DirectoryPage.tsx`) is a second item finder — follow-up to retire or route it; N2 one environment list read per type per open (declared); N3 guard the surface's own `CommandPaletteProvider` with `useCommandPaletteProviderMounted()`; N4 `ResourceEditPage` Escape on `window` ignores `defaultPrevented` (palette Escape over a fullscreen editor may also leave fullscreen) — check; N5 nothing in Studio advertises ⌘K.

Out of scope, pre-existing: the surface header's own departures (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ~1213, ~1348, ~1483) share M1's blind spot — fold into M1's fix if the same guard covers them, else the zone files a defect card.

Landing K: 27 — merge `main` in the round. Delta L1 on the new head.

## Live walk-through — #36900 ⌘K (L1 D2), REWORK round 1

Head under test: `5e181efb6` (the walk ran on `7126dfea1`, whose src is identical; the later commit touches test files only).

**Stack.** Run in this container. `pnpm build` (turbo, 120 tasks); backend `OS_PORT=38517 pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38517` (showcase, `--seed-admin`, 141 seed rows); Console `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console exec vite --port 5187 --strictPort` with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET` on that backend, so app-shell is served from `src` at this head. Driven by headless Chromium (Playwright, `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) as a person would: UI sign-in as the seeded admin, Ctrl+K, type the item's label, wait for the highlighted row, Enter. Both servers were stopped by PID afterwards.

**Result: every step passed.**

    signed in -> /
    walking package com.example.showcase
      object: 24 in com.example.showcase; walking showcase_cascade ("Cascading Select")
      flow: 33 in com.example.showcase; walking showcase_committee_quorum ("High-Value Expense — Committee Quorum")
      permission: 9 in com.example.showcase; walking showcase_auditor ("Showcase Auditor")
      hook: 8 in com.example.showcase; walking showcase_guard_paid_invoice_line_add ("Guard Paid Invoice Line Add")
      dashboard: 3 in com.example.showcase; walking showcase_revenue_pulse ("Revenue Pulse")
    at /studio/com.example.showcase/data
    1. Ctrl+K on the Data page opens the palette; groups: Data | UI | Automation | Platform | Access | Packages | Preferences
       items listed: 253, menu entries: 25
       highlighted before Enter: studio-item object showcase_cascade
    2. object "Cascading Select": found by its label, opened /studio/com.example.showcase/data?surface=object%3Ashowcase_cascade; its label on the page: yes
       highlighted before Enter: studio-item flow showcase_committee_quorum
    3. flow "High-Value Expense — Committee Quorum": found by its label, opened /studio/com.example.showcase/automations?surface=flow%3Ashowcase_committee_quorum; its label on the page: yes
       highlighted before Enter: studio-item permission showcase_auditor
    4. permission "Showcase Auditor": found by its label, opened /studio/com.example.showcase/access?surface=permission%3Ashowcase_auditor; its label on the page: yes (first heading "Showcase Auditor")
       highlighted before Enter: studio-item hook showcase_guard_paid_invoice_line_add
    5. hook "Guard Paid Invoice Line Add": found by its label, opened /studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/hook/showcase_guard_paid_invoice_line_add?package=com.example.showcase; its label on the page: yes
       highlighted before Enter: studio-item dashboard showcase_revenue_pulse
    6. dashboard "Revenue Pulse": found by its label, opened /studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/dashboard/showcase_revenue_pulse?package=com.example.showcase; its label on the page: yes
    7. Ctrl+K on the cross-package catalog opens the palette, with its menu entries: 6
    8. customization package com.example.showcase.custom (ensure 200); doc saved there: 200
       the item page is on /studio/com.example.showcase.custom/metadata/doc/walk_36900_doc
       unsaved edit, pick "Organization flows": asked 1 time(s) ("You have unsaved changes. Leave this page anyway?"); Cancel kept the page, edit still there: yes
       Back to app with the edit: asked 1 time(s); Cancel kept the page
       OK: asked 1 time(s), left for /studio/~org/automations
       selected before Enter: studio-entry owd
    9. on the Access page (Showcase Auditor), pick Default sharing: overview shown before 0, after 1; at /studio/com.example.showcase/access?surface=owd%3Aoverview

Reading it:
- 2 to 6: one item each of object, flow, permission set, hook and dashboard, as the card's acceptance asks. None is its type's first item, so a page that opened on its default proves nothing. Each was found by its label and opened at the address its list row leads to, with its label on the opened page. Step 2 also exercises the same-page re-entry: from the Data page to another object.
- 7: the cross-package catalog has Ctrl+K again.
- 8 (M1): a real "All metadata" item page with an unsaved edit, a doc in the showcase's customization package created for the walk. The palette pick asks once with the page's own question; Cancel keeps the page and the edit; Back to app asks too; OK leaves.
- 9 (S5): Default sharing picked on the Access page opens the overview (not shown before, shown after).

**Not measured: HotCRM.** No HotCRM checkout or stack exists in this container; the walk covers the showcase app only.

**Two observations from the walk (no defect filed):**
- With zero delay between Escape and the next Ctrl+K (an automated reopen), a query typed before the lists answered left no row highlighted, so Enter did nothing. With no earlier close, or with a 1 s gap, measured three times (twice without the candidate fix below), the row that arrives is highlighted and Enter opens it. A first-row-selection fix was tried and then dropped: live, it changed nothing a person can reach.
- An item of the customization package opens on that package's own Studio scope, as its list row does, so the palette there lists that package's menu.

Screenshots of every step were taken locally; they are not attachable through the relay.

- **S2: closed.** `scopeListRows` with the list page's `listInclude`, pinned.
- **S3: closed.** The app-shell README documents `surface`, the provider guard and the seam.
- **S4: closed.** A customization item reads "Customization of {package name}" (pinned: no `.custom` text); the changeset is in product terms.
- **S5: closed.** The re-entry latch waits for the requested query; pinned on the real Access pillar and walked live.
- **N3, N4: closed** (provider guard on both mounts; `ResourceEditPage`'s Escape checks `defaultPrevented`, pinned).
- **D2: closed for this card.** The showcase walk-through (7145761753) covers every acceptance type, each a non-first item opened at its list-row address, plus `~all`, M1 on a real item page and S5 re-entry. The code has no app-specific branch. The HotCRM leg was not measured (no HotCRM stack in the container); #36910, the joint walk-through card, carries it — noted there.
- **Before landing (body, not code):** the PR body still describes `c787516002` (size, "walk-through NOT MEASURED", the old leave path and re-reads, no M1/S5/N4 pins). The zone refreshes it to this head — a body edit does not move the head.
- **Nits (zone's discretion):** N6 `useStudioMenuTypes` no longer memoizes `types` and the provider value is a new object each render (re-renders only); N7 the customization label briefly shows the base package's id while the package entry loads; N8 the English changeset carries inline Chinese group names.
